subCategories.name: 1.1 Boot & Startup
subCategories.description: Checks BIOS/UEFI, Secure Boot, TPM initialization, Kernel-Boot operational logs, and startup driver errors.

subCategories.name: 1.2 Shutdown & Restart
subCategories.description: Queries System log for unexpected shutdowns, Kernel-Power (41), Event 6008, and user-initiated restarts (1074).

subCategories.name: 1.3 OS Stability & Crashes
subCategories.description: Collects BSOD/BugChecks (1001), Application crashes/hangs (1000/1002), recent minidumps, and Reliability Stability Index.

subCategories.name: 2.1 PowerShell Modules & Libraries
subCategories.description: Audits installed PowerShell modules and PackageManagement packages/libraries.

subCategories.name: 2.2 Installed Applications (Winget & Native)
subCategories.description: Reports installed MSI/EXE applications from native Windows Uninstall keys and WinGet.

subCategories.name: 2.3 Autoruns & Startup Analysis
subCategories.description: Analyzes Registry Run/RunOnce, Startup folders, Boot/Logon Scheduled Tasks, and Auto-Start Services.

subCategories.name: 2.4 Disks, Partitions & Volumes
subCategories.description: Reports detailed Physical Disk, Partition (GPT/MBR, offsets), and Volume (FS, cluster size, free GB) info.

subCategories.name: 2.5 Local Users & Groups
subCategories.description: Audits local user accounts, last logon timestamps, local groups, and group memberships.

subCategories.name: 2.6 Local & Group Policy Settings
subCategories.description: Inspects applied Computer Group Policy (gpresult /R) and HKLM Policy registry settings.

subCategories.name: 2.7 iSCSI Connections & Targets
subCategories.description: Reports MSiSCSI service state, Target Portals, iSCSI Targets, Sessions, and active Connections.

subCategories.name: 2.8 Failover Cluster Status
subCategories.description: Audits Failover Cluster nodes, roles/groups, resources, CSVs, and FailoverClustering Operational events.

subCategories.name: 2.9 NTFS Shares, Permissions & Open Files
subCategories.description: Reports SMB share & NTFS ACL permissions plus open SMB files and top processes holding file handles.

subCategories.name: 2.10 Disk Deduplication & Raw Storage
subCategories.description: Audits Data Deduplication volumes and calculates total raw logical storage required if deduplication were disabled.

subCategories.name: 2.11 Volume Shadow Copies (VSS)
subCategories.description: Lists Volume Shadow Copies (Win32_ShadowCopy), shadow storage allocation, and VSS writer health.

subCategories.name: 2.12 DHCP Scopes & Options
subCategories.description: Queries DHCP Server IPv4 scopes, utilization statistics, and server/scope DHCP options.

subCategories.name: 2.13 Firewall Profiles & Active Rules
subCategories.description: Reports Domain/Private/Public firewall profile states and enabled firewall rules with port filters.

subCategories.name: 2.14 SQL Server Diagnostics
subCategories.description: Inspects SQL Server services, TCP listeners, databases/recovery models, blocking SPIDs, and SQL error events.

subCategories.name: 3.1 Processor (CPU) & WHEA
subCategories.description: Inspects CPU sockets, load %, thermal sensors (where exposed), and WHEA-Logger / Kernel-Processor-Power events.

subCategories.name: 3.2 Memory (RAM) & Commit
subCategories.description: Audits RAM & commit usage, pagefiles, physical DIMMs, Resource Exhaustion Detector (2004), and MemoryDiagnostics events.

subCategories.name: 3.3 Motherboard, PCI & Bus Errors
subCategories.description: Inspects baseboard/BIOS info, faulty PnP devices (ConfigManagerErrorCode != 0), and WHEA/PCI/ACPI bus errors.

subCategories.name: 3.4 Graphics & Display TDR
subCategories.description: Checks display adapters, driver versions, and Display / DxgKrnl TDR reset events (4101).

subCategories.name: 3.5 USB Devices & Kernel-PnP
subCategories.description: Audits USB devices with error codes and Kernel-PnP / USBHUB enumeration & disconnect warnings.

subCategories.name: 3.6 Printers & Print Spooler
subCategories.description: Checks Print Spooler service, installed printer queues/drivers, and PrintService Admin/Operational errors.

subCategories.name: 4.1 Physical Disks & S.M.A.R.T.
subCategories.description: Inspects physical disk health, SMART/storage reliability counters, and Disk/StorPort/StorAHCI I/O errors.

subCategories.name: 4.2 File System (NTFS / ReFS)
subCategories.description: Reports fixed volume capacity & low-space warnings plus NTFS, ReFS, and Chkdsk error events.

subCategories.name: 4.3 Storage Spaces
subCategories.description: Audits Storage Spaces pools, virtual disks, pool degradation, and StorageSpaces-Driver events.

subCategories.name: 4.4 BitLocker
subCategories.description: Inspects BitLocker volume protection status, key protectors, and BitLocker-API/Management events.

subCategories.name: 5.1 Network Adapters
subCategories.description: Audits NIC link status, negotiated speed, Rx/Tx packet errors & discards, and NDIS/driver events.

subCategories.name: 5.2 TCP/IP Stack & Sockets
subCategories.description: Lists active TCP sockets, listening ports, remote endpoints, and owning processes.

subCategories.name: 5.3 DHCP Client
subCategories.description: Audits DHCP Client service, adapter lease configs, and Dhcp-Client Admin/Operational errors.

subCategories.name: 5.4 DNS Client
subCategories.description: Inspects configured DNS servers, Dnscache service state, DNS Client errors (1014), and optional live lookup test.

subCategories.name: 5.5 Wireless (WLAN)
subCategories.description: Checks WlanSvc, wireless interface signal/state, and WLAN-AutoConfig Operational warnings (graceful on headless servers).

subCategories.name: 5.6 VPN (RasClient / IKEEXT)
subCategories.description: Checks RasMan/IKEEXT services, VPN profiles, and RasClient / IKEEXT tunnel failure events.

subCategories.name: 5.7 Windows Firewall, WFP & pfirewall.log
subCategories.description: Checks Windows Firewall profiles, WFP Operational logs, Security Log drops (5152, 5157), and pfirewall.log over SMB.

subCategories.name: 5.8 Network Subsystem Event Logs
subCategories.description: Reads Microsoft-Windows-TCPIP, NDIS, Winsock-AFD, WFP, Kernel-Network, SMBServer, DNS-Client, and WinINet logs.

subCategories.name: 5.9 DHCP Server Logs & Events
subCategories.description: Reads DhcpSrvLog-*.txt over SMB (latest or past 1-6 days) and queries DHCP Server Windows Event Logs.

subCategories.name: 6.1 Printer Status & Operational Overview
subCategories.description: Queries Print Spooler service health, spool directory backlog, and operational status of all configured printers via Get-Printer.

subCategories.name: 6.2 Print Jobs & Queue Activity
subCategories.description: Queries active, queued, paused, stuck, and errored print jobs across all printers using Get-Printer and Get-PrintJob.

subCategories.name: 6.3 Printer Drivers, Ports & Point-and-Print
subCategories.description: Inventories installed printer drivers (v3 vs v4), printer ports (TCP/IP, WSD, Local), printer usage counts, and Point & Print hardening.

subCategories.name: 6.4 PrintService Event Logs & Audit
subCategories.description: Audits Microsoft-Windows-PrintService Admin & Operational logs (IDs 307, 372, 808) and System Spooler crash events.

subCategories.name: 7.1 Logon & Account Lockouts
subCategories.description: Queries Security log for failed logons (4625), lockouts (4740), Kerberos pre-auth (4771), and NTLM (4776) with decoded failure reasons.

subCategories.name: 7.2 Kerberos
subCategories.description: Inspects domain membership, System Kerberos/Netlogon errors, and Security Kerberos ticket failures (4768, 4769, 4771).

subCategories.name: 7.3 NTLM
subCategories.description: Queries Microsoft-Windows-NTLM/Operational to pinpoint legacy NTLM callers, clients, and target servers.

subCategories.name: 7.4 Group Policy
subCategories.description: Audits GroupPolicy/Operational for processing failures, warnings, and slow CSE extension durations.

subCategories.name: 8.1 Microsoft Defender
subCategories.description: Inspects Defender Real-Time Protection, signature age, and Operational threat/scan/update events.

subCategories.name: 8.2 Credential Guard & VBS
subCategories.description: Checks Win32_DeviceGuard VBS / Credential Guard / HVCI state and DeviceGuard/LSA Operational events.

subCategories.name: 8.3 AppLocker
subCategories.description: Audits AppIDSvc status and AppLocker blocked/audited execution events (EXE, DLL, MSI, Script, Packaged).

subCategories.name: 8.4 WDAC (Code Integrity)
subCategories.description: Checks WDAC Kernel/User-mode enforcement state and CodeIntegrity Operational block/audit events (3076, 3077).

subCategories.name: 8.5 SmartScreen & Mitigations
subCategories.description: Audits SmartScreen configuration and Security-Mitigations / SmartScreen events.

subCategories.name: 8.6 Security Auditing (4672/4688/4697)
subCategories.description: Queries Security Auditing events for special privilege logons (4672), process starts (4688), new services (4697), and logons.

subCategories.name: 9.1 User Profile Service & FSLogix
subCategories.description: Detects corrupt (.bak) and temporary profiles, User Profile Service errors, and FSLogix Apps/CloudCache events.

subCategories.name: 10.1 Service Control Manager & Stopped Auto Services
subCategories.description: Detects Automatic services currently stopped and queries Service Control Manager crash, dependency, and timeout events.

subCategories.name: 11.1 Windows Update & Pending Reboot
subCategories.description: Checks pending reboot flags, recent HotFixes, and WindowsUpdateClient install/rollback events.

subCategories.name: 11.2 WSUS Client & Detection
subCategories.description: Audits WSUS GPO registry configuration, last detection timestamp, WSUS Server role (if present), and sync failures.

subCategories.name: 12.1 Machine Certificates & CAPI2
subCategories.description: Audits Cert:\LocalMachine\My for expired or soon-expiring certificates and queries CAPI2 operational errors.

subCategories.name: 13.1 RDP / Terminal Services
subCategories.description: Inspects RDP config (Enabled, Port, NLA, TermService) and TerminalServices logon/disconnect events with user & client IP.

subCategories.name: 13.2 WinRM & PowerShell Remoting
subCategories.description: Checks WinRM service, active WS-Man listeners, TrustedHosts, and WinRM Operational errors.

subCategories.name: 13.3 Active RDP Sessions (qwinsta / rwinsta)
subCategories.description: Queries active Terminal/RDP sessions via native qwinsta /server:<Server> and allows disconnecting/resetting sessions via rwinsta.

subCategories.name: 14.1 .NET Runtime & CLR Crashes
subCategories.description: Inventories installed .NET Framework version and queries .NET Runtime CLR crash/exception events.

subCategories.name: 14.2 COM / DCOM Activation & Permissions
subCategories.description: Queries System log for DistributedCOM activation timeouts and permission errors (10016, 10010, etc.).

subCategories.name: 14.3 PowerShell Operational
subCategories.description: Checks ExecutionPolicy and queries PowerShell Operational / Core logs for script and module warnings/errors.

subCategories.name: 15.1 Hyper-V
subCategories.description: Audits Hyper-V VMs, states, memory/CPU allocation, and VMMS/Hypervisor Admin events (graceful when absent).

subCategories.name: 15.2 WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux)
subCategories.description: Checks WSL service/status and LxssManager/WslService error events (graceful when absent).

subCategories.name: 16.1 Microsoft Entra ID (dsregcmd)
subCategories.description: Captures dsregcmd /status join/PRT state and User Device Registration / AAD Operational errors.

subCategories.name: 16.2 Intune & MDM Enrollment
subCategories.description: Audits MDM enrollment registry state, IntuneManagementExtension service, and DeviceManagement Enterprise Admin events.

subCategories.name: 17.1 IIS Websites, App Pools & WAS/W3SVC
subCategories.description: Audits IIS Websites, App Pool states, bindings, and WAS/W3SVC/HTTP System errors (gracefully detects non-IIS servers).

subCategories.name: 18.1 SMB Shares & Sessions
subCategories.description: Audits SMB server config (SMB1/encryption), SMB shares, active client sessions, and SMBServer/SMBClient Connectivity logs.

subCategories.name: 18.2 DFS & DFS Replication
subCategories.description: Checks DFSR/DFS services, replicated folder states, and DFS Replication error events (graceful when absent).

subCategories.name: 19.1 Task Scheduler Failures
subCategories.description: Identifies scheduled tasks with non-zero LastTaskResult and queries TaskScheduler/Operational errors.

subCategories.name: 20.1 W32Time / NTP & Clock Drift
subCategories.description: Checks W32Time service, NTP source & stratum (w32tm /query /status), and Time-Service System warnings.

subCategories.name: 21.1 KMS / MAK & Security-SPP
subCategories.description: Audits Windows OS license status, KMS server, grace period, and Security-SPP Application errors.

subCategories.name: 22.1 Live CPU, Memory, GPU, Network & Top Processes
subCategories.description: Live interactive performance & network/GPU monitor (1-15s SQLite-backed polling + charts) plus one-shot snapshot & CSV export.

subCategories.name: 23.1 Event Log Health, Full & Cleared Logs
subCategories.description: Checks EventLog service, core log file sizes/retention modes, and Log Cleared (104/1102) or Full (1104) events.

subCategories.name: 24.1 SFC, DISM Component Store & Reliability
subCategories.description: Runs read-only DISM /CheckHealth, scans CBS.log for WRP corruption lines, and pulls Reliability Monitor records.

subCategories.name: 25.1 Local Troubleshooting Terminal
subCategories.description: Interactive faux troubleshooting terminal that executes built-in Windows/PowerShell commands strictly on localhost under the host process identity (SYSTEM / local user) without using remote session credentials.
